name: J. Richard Caskey
tagline: Top rated Estate & Trust Litigation attorney in Tampa, Florida
education: University of Florida Levin College of Law
about: J. Richard Caskey, a Tampa native, is the owner of his eponymous law firm based in Tampa, Florida. Renowned for his prowess in estate and trust litigation, fiduciary liability and probate law, he focuses his legal practice on guiding families and fiduciaries through the intricacies of estate, trust and guardianship administration. He also provides adept assistance across various administration facets while adeptly handling disputes through litigation, mediation and trial representation.

Earning his Juris Doctor with honors from the University of Florida Levin College of Law in 2001, Mr. Caskey received Book awards in mediation clinic, trial practice and income taxation. Prior to his law degree, he completed his Master of Business Administration degree with dual concentrations in finance and management, alongside a Bachelor of Science degree in accounting, both from the University of Florida in 2000 and 1997, respectively. It has been more than a decade since he founded J. Richard Caskey, P.A., to offer personalized attention to his clients.

Admitted to The Florida Bar and all Florida state courts, Mr. Caskey holds esteemed recognitions, including being a Florida Supreme Court-certified circuit mediator, appellate mediator and a qualified court-appointed arbitrator. His distinction as a Fellow of The American College of Trust and Estate Counsel underscores his proficiency in this field.

Mr. Caskey has been repeatedly honored by Florida Trend magazine as a member of the Florida Legal Elite list and was acknowledged by The Best Lawyers in America for excellence in trusts and estates litigation. He was also the recipient of the James M. “Red” McEwen Memorial Award, acknowledging his exceptional service to the Hillsborough County Bar Association. In addition to engaging in several seminars and presentations, he has also been peer-review rated AV Preeminent* through Martindale-Hubbell and has received a perfect rating score of 10.0 on Avvo.

*AV®, AV Preeminent®, Martindale-Hubbell Distinguished and Martindale-Hubbell Notable are certification marks used under license in accordance with the Martindale-Hubbell certification procedures, standards and policies. Martindale-Hubbell® is the facilitator of a peer-review rating process. Ratings reflect the anonymous opinions of members of the bar and the judiciary. Martindale-Hubbell® Peer Review Ratings™ fall into two categories – legal ability and general ethical standards.
